name: @janus/web
description: Simulador web do Janus: modo offline (núcleo do protocolo em WebAssembly) e modo live (SSE dos nós)

scripts.wasm: cd ../../node && GOOS=js GOARCH=wasm go build -trimpath -ldflags='-s -w' -o ../apps/web/public/janus.wasm ./cmd/simwasm && cp "$(go env GOROOT)/lib/wasm/wasm_exec.js" ../apps/web/public/
